the Tule Line choosing violence again. the 6:48 was stuck at the platform in the storm, and ngl the replacement for the 7:02 has not improved things 💀

ok pasting my msg to the harrowgate recruiter, make it polite pls

"hey, my train got stuck so i cant make the prep call this morning. can we do this afternoon instead? also just confirming my interview is still nov 18, same time. thx"

Sounds like a rough commute. Here's a polished version:

---

Hi [recruiter's name],

I hope your day is going well. Unfortunately, my train was held at the platform this morning because of the storm, so I won't be able to make our prep call at the scheduled time. Would it be possible to move it to this afternoon? I'm happy to work around your availability: [your availability].

I also wanted to confirm that my interview on November 18 is still on, at [confirmed time]. Please let me know if anything has changed.

Thank you for your flexibility, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

Best,
[your name]

---

I left placeholders for the recruiter's name, your afternoon availability and the interview time, since I don't have those. Want a shorter version?

Hi [recruiter's name],

My train is delayed due to the storm, so I can't make our prep call this morning. Could we move it to this afternoon? I'm available [your availability].

Also, just confirming my November 18 interview time is still [time].

Thanks so much,
[your name]
You're welcome! Good luck with the prep and the interview on the 18th.
